common.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
common.offline: You are offline. Check your connection and try again.
common.loadFailed: NeoText could not load. Check your connection and try again.

auth.setupIntro: Create the password for this server. You will use it to sign in.
auth.passwordMismatch: The passwords do not match. Type the same password in both fields.
auth.wrongPassword: That password is not right. Check it and try again.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait {{minutes}} minutes and try again.
auth.recoveryKeyBody: This key is the only way to get back in if you forget your password. NeoText cannot reset it for you.
auth.displayNameHint: Optional. Shown instead of your username.
auth.recoveryKeyHonest: If you lose both your password and this key, nobody can recover your chats unless the server admin has turned on recovery escrow. Encryption protects the database file if it is stolen. It does not hide your chats from whoever runs this server, or from the model provider you send them to.
auth.copyFailed: Could not copy the key. Select it and copy it by hand.

setup.modeCommunityHint: People join with an invite. You manage who can use it.
setup.useEnvProvider: Use the OpenRouter key from this server
setup.useEnvProviderHint: The key stays on the server and never reaches your browser.
setup.providerBody: Paste an OpenRouter key to start chatting. You can change providers later in settings.

register.title: Create your account
register.intro: Enter the invite code you were given, then choose a username and password.

errors.closed: Sign-ups are closed on this server. Ask the admin for access.
errors.invite_invalid: That invite code did not work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.username_taken: That username is taken. Pick another one.

recover.title: Reset your password
recover.intro: Enter your username and the recovery key you saved when you set up your account.
recover.newKeyBody: The old key no longer works. This new key is the only way to get back in if you forget your password again.

auth.escrowNote: The admin of this NeoText can reset your password.

sidebar.empty: No chats yet. Start a new chat to begin.
sidebar.pinnedEmpty: Drag chats here to pin them.
sidebar.loadFailed: Chats could not load. Check your connection and try again.
sidebar.deleteFolderBody: Chats in this folder move up one level.
sidebar.smartEmpty: No chats match this filter yet.

customizer.description: Changes show in the sidebar right away.
customizer.dragHelp: Press space to pick up a section, the arrow keys to move it, and space again to drop it.
customizer.cancelled: Move cancelled. {{title}} is back where it was.
customizer.resetBody: Order, position, width and quick actions go back to the defaults, and smart sections you made are removed. Chats are not affected.

smart.title: Add smart section
smart.description: A smart section lists the chats that match a filter. It updates as your chats change.
smart.name: Section name
smart.previewFailed: Matches could not be counted. Check your connection and try again.

presets.empty: Save a prompt and model you use often.
presets.loadFailed: Presets could not load. Check your connection and try again.
presets.deleteBody: Chats that started from this preset keep their messages and go back to your default settings.

editor.name: Name
editor.nameTooLong: Use 60 characters or fewer for the name.
editor.systemPromptHint: Leave empty to use your default system prompt.
editor.promptTooLong: The system prompt can be at most 20,000 characters. Shorten it and save again.
editor.maxTokensInvalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 200,000.
editor.invalid: Check the preset settings and try again.

presets.gone: That preset was deleted. Your message was not sent; send it again to chat without it.

compare.chosen: {{count}} of {{max}} chosen. Pick a chosen model again to remove it.
compare.limit: You can compare up to {{count}} models.

agents.none: No agents yet. Add one in Settings, Agents.

approval.title: {{tool}} wants to run
approval.hint: The answer waits for your choice. Always allow stops asking for this tool.
approval.announce: {{tool}} wants to run. Choose Allow, Always allow or Decline.
approval.tooLong: This request is too long to review here, so it can't be allowed. You can decline it.

tools.unreachable: This answer cannot be reached right now. Check your connection and try again.

chat.emptyBody: Ask a question, paste some text, or attach a file.
chat.streamFailed: The reply stopped before it finished. Try again.
chat.noModels: No models are available. Add your API key in settings.
chat.notFound: This chat does not exist or was deleted. Start a new chat from the sidebar.
chat.loadFailed: This chat could not load. Check your connection and try again.

notes.interrupted: The server restarted while this was being written. You can regenerate it.
notes.length: Cut off at the length limit.
notes.unknown: This answer may be cut off.
notes.lost: Lost the connection. Reload to see the rest.

snippets.variablesIntro: Fill in the blanks, then the snippet goes into your message.

composer.label: Message
composer.hintEnter: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line
composer.hintMod: Ctrl or Cmd+Enter sends, Enter starts a new line
composer.hintTouch: Enter starts a new line, tap Send to send

models.empty: No models yet. Connect a provider to see its models.
models.loadFailed: The model list could not load. Check your connection and try again.

sheet.connect: Connect a model provider to start.
sheet.noModels: None of your providers has a model to offer yet. Check the provider in settings.

errors.thinkingBudget: The model used its whole answer budget on thinking. Try again, or raise the answer length or lower the reasoning effort.
errors.quotaExceeded: You've reached your {{period}} budget of {{limit}}. Raise it in Usage, or wait for the next period.
errors.quotaExceededPlain: You've reached your budget. Raise it in Usage, or wait for the next period.
errors.sharedQuotaExceeded: You've used your {{period}} budget on shared models ({{amount}}). It resets {{reset}} (UTC). You can also add your own key in Settings → Providers.

attachments.tooLarge: This file is over 20 MB. Pick a smaller file.
attachments.quotaFull: Your files have reached the storage limit of {{limit}} MB. Delete chats with files you no longer need and empty the trash, then try again.
attachments.tooMany: A message can carry up to {{max}} files. Remove one to add another.
attachments.unsupported: This file type isn't supported. Attach images, PDFs or text files.
attachments.mismatch: This file's content doesn't match its type. Check the file and try again.
attachments.failed: The upload failed. Remove the file and try again.
attachments.waiting: Wait for the files to finish uploading, then send.

project.title: Preview
project.offline: Not loaded, the preview is offline:
project.noHtml: This project has no HTML page to preview.
project.empty: This chat has no project yet.

usage.title: Usage
usage.intro: What your chats cost, per day and per model, as the providers report it.
usage.loadFailed: Usage could not load. Check your connection and try again.
usage.unknownCost_one: {{count}} request has no known cost and is not in the total.
usage.unknownCost_other: {{count}} requests have no known cost and are not in the total.
usage.chartEmpty: No cost recorded in this range.
usage.empty: Nothing used in this range yet.

budget.title: Budget
budget.intro: Spending limits for your chats. Days and months follow this device's time zone. Requests with no known cost don't count toward the limits.
budget.limitError: Enter an amount above 0, or leave the box empty.
budget.warnHint: A notice appears once a day or month when spending reaches this share of a limit.
budget.warnError: Enter a whole number from 50 to 100.
budget.hardStop: Stop new messages at the limit
budget.hardStopHint: An answer being written still finishes. New messages wait for a higher limit or the next period.
budget.blocked: A limit is reached, so new messages are stopped. Raise the limit or wait for the next period.

alerts.monthly: You've used {{percent}}% of this month's budget.

usage.chatCost: Total cost of this chat, all branches: {{cost}}

shared.title: Shared models
shared.intro: Your admin sets how much you can spend on shared models. Your own providers are not limited. Days and months are in UTC.
shared.exhausted: You've used your budget on shared models. Your own providers still work.

shell.contextMeter: Context window: {{used}} of {{limit}} tokens used ({{left}} left)

search.description: Search the titles and messages of all your chats.

shell.settingsRecovered: Some saved settings couldn't be read, so defaults were used. Restore a previous version in Settings → Data.
